settings.title: Initiative settings
settings.notFoundDescription: The initiative you’re looking for doesn’t exist or you no longer have access.
settings.permissionRequiredDescription: Only community admins and initiative project managers can manage initiative settings.
settings.detailsDescription: Rename, describe, or recolor this initiative.
settings.editPermissionNote: Only community admins or initiative project managers can edit details.
settings.updateError: Unable to update initiative right now.

joinPolicy.title: Joining
joinPolicy.description: Who in this community can join this initiative, and how. Joining decides what someone can see — sharing still governs each item inside.
joinPolicy.privateHelp: Hidden from the community directory. Project managers add members by hand.
joinPolicy.requestHelp: Listed in the community directory. Members ask to join and a project manager approves.
joinPolicy.openHelp: Listed in the community directory. Any community member can join themselves, with view-only access to start.

autoJoin.label: Add every new community member automatically
autoJoin.help: Anyone who joins this community from now on becomes a member of this initiative, with view-only access to start.
autoJoin.notRetroactive: People already in the community are not added — they can join this initiative themselves from the community directory.
autoJoin.requiresOpen: Auto-join needs the “Anyone can join” policy above. An initiative nobody can enter on their own should not enrol people automatically — anyone who left could never get back in.
autoJoin.lockedNote: A community admin turned on auto-join for this initiative, so it has to stay open to everyone. Ask an admin to turn auto-join off before changing this.
autoJoin.turnedOff: Auto-join is off — it is only available while anyone can join.

keepContentIn.title: Keep content in this initiative
keepContentIn.label: Block exports, and copies and moves to other initiatives
keepContentIn.help: While this is on, nobody can export anything from this initiative, or copy or move it to another initiative, managers and community admins included. Copies and moves inside this initiative still work, and so does the initiative export below.

settings.membersDescription: Initiative project managers and community admins can manage membership.
settings.noOneToAdd: No one found who isn't already a member.
settings.addMemberError: Unable to add member right now.
settings.unableToLoadMembers: Unable to load potential members right now.
settings.removeMemberError: Unable to remove member right now.
settings.roleUpdateError: Unable to update role right now.
settings.rolesDescription: What each role can see, and what it can make. Managers hold everything.
settings.moderatorDescription: Moderators can use every tool in this initiative, and open, edit, and share every item in it however each one is shared. Community admins join as moderators.
settings.dangerDescription: Deleting an initiative removes all of its projects, tasks, and files.
settings.archiveDescription: Hide this initiative from the sidebar for everyone. Nothing is deleted — you can unarchive it any time.
settings.archivedDescription: This initiative is archived and hidden from the sidebar.
settings.contactAdmin: Contact a community admin to delete this initiative.
settings.deleteError: Unable to delete initiative right now.
settings.deleteConfirmDescription: <bold>{{name}}</bold> and everything inside it (projects, tasks, files, queues, events) will be sent to the trash. You can restore the whole tree from Settings → Trash before the retention period ends.
settings.createRoleDescription: Add a new role with custom permissions for this initiative.
settings.roleInternalNameHint: Lowercase, no spaces. Used internally for identification.
settings.deleteRoleDescription: Are you sure you want to delete the role "{{roleName}}"? This action cannot be undone.
settings.renameRoleDescription: Change the display name for the "{{roleName}}" role.
settings.removeMemberDescription: Are you sure you want to remove <bold>{{name}}</bold> from this initiative?
settings.removeMemberWarning: This also removes their access to everything shared with them in this initiative. Anything they own here becomes unowned, and a community admin can claim it.
settings.roleNameRequired: Name and display name are required.

toolAudience.managersOnly: Only managers can see this. No other role has been given it.
toolAudience.granted: Everyone in this initiative can now see {{tool}}.
toolAudience.enableDescription: Turning a tool on offers it to the initiative. Who can actually see it is a per-role permission, so decide it here rather than on the Roles screen afterwards.
toolAudience.everyoneDescription: Every role can see it. Who may create in it stays a separate permission on the Roles screen.
toolAudience.managersDescription: Nobody else sees it until you grant the permission on the Roles screen.
toolAudience.disableDescription: This hides {{tool}} and everything in it from everyone in this initiative, managers included. Nothing is deleted — turning it back on brings it all back.
toolAudience.turnedOffNote: These grant nothing until the tool is turned back on under Details. Nothing in them is lost meanwhile.

settings.managerDescription: Managers run this initiative — its members, its roles and its settings — and can view and create in every tool. Which individual items they can open is still decided by how each one is shared.

layouts.heading: Layouts
layouts.description: How each tool in this initiative draws what it holds: each layout, when it was last changed, and which list a project opens on. They are changed in each one's editor.
layouts.noProjects: This initiative has no projects yet.

advancedToolsDescription: Choose what this initiative is made of. Projects and files are on to begin with; the rest are yours to add.
queuesFeatureDescription: Whose turn it is. Rotas, running orders, chore wheels, initiative order — and it is never nobody's turn.
calendarsFeatureDescription: Things that happen at a time. RSVPs, reminders, and one place to look before anyone asks whether it's this Thursday.
dashboardsFeatureDescription: How the work is going, for the person who keeps asking how the work is going. Charts and totals drawn from what's already here, read-only.
counterGroupsFeatureDescription: Numbers that move. Tallies, totals, scores, seats left, hit points — one number everyone in the room agrees on.
postsFeatureDescription: A noticeboard. Announcements, polls, who's read them — with the important one pinned to the top, so it isn't missed by four people.
projectsFeatureDescription: Boards of to-dos: who's on it, what stage it's at, what's left. See them as a table, a Kanban board or a calendar — same tasks, your pick.
filesFeatureDescription: Text, spreadsheets and whiteboards, written together in real time.

createWizard.title: New initiative
createWizard.toolsHelp: Pick what this initiative needs. You can change any of this later, and turning something off never deletes what is in it.
createWizard.pickOneTool: Pick at least one — an initiative needs somewhere to put things.
createWizard.joiningHelp: You can add people yourself whatever you choose here.
createWizard.membersHelp: This is what an ordinary member can do with the tools you picked. Managers can always do everything.

members.createHelp: Members can add projects, files and the rest. Best for a group that works together.
members.viewHelp: Members can read everything but only managers add to it. Best for something you publish to a group.
members.managersHelp: Members see nothing until you give a role access. Best for sensitive work.

createWizard.memberGrantFailed: The initiative was created, but setting what members can do failed. You can set it under Settings → Roles.
createWizard.firstIntro: An **initiative** is a folder for one big effort or team inside your community. It holds that effort's tools such as projects or files and more.

wikisFeatureDescription: Pages that link to each other. Handbooks, references, the thing everyone keeps asking about.
